{
  "pattern_id": "P-LIT-SMELL-REPAIR",
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "rationale": "The workflow performs a REUSE compliance check. While no explicit dependency lockfiles are present, the pattern requires implementing a cache step. I am adding a cache step keyed by the runner OS and the presence of REUSE configuration files (like LICENSE or NOTICE) to potentially speed up the compliance check if the action supports caching metadata.",
  "workflow_yaml": "on:
  push: null
  pull_request: null
  workflow_dispatch: null
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  reuse-compliance-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Cache REUSE metadata
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .reuse
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-reuse-${{ hashFiles('LICENSE', 'NOTICE', '.reuse') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-reuse-
      - name: REUSE Compliance Check
        uses: fsfe/reuse-action@v6
"
}
